integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 2D-animated, minimalist black line animation on a flat, digitally pure-white canvas with no texture, no gradient, no shadow, and no depth. Use minimalist two-dimensional black line animation. Show the same consistent stick figure with a hollow circular head, occasional simple line expressions, no detailed facial features, no hair, no clothing, no filled body, stable proportions, connected line limbs, and uniform medium line weight. Exactly two arms and two legs are visible per figure. Each limb appears only in its current pose: raising or lowering the right arm replaces that arm's previous line, never leaving a resting arm beneath an active arm. The figure stays black; accent colors affect only props and graphic effects. Three identical stick figures appear in this segment, all built to that same description. A low, floor-level medium shot frames the same closed electric-blue snake from the previous segment on the same flat white floor. The center figure crouches beside it with a smug simple line expression and his hollow circular head tilted slightly up. His left hand lifts the warm-gold wine vessel with the short curved handle to chest height, and his right hand picks up the line tip and presses it against the middle of the snake's body. The other two figures keep crouching in the soft background at frame left and frame right, still dragging their own electric-blue lines. An off-screen adult male narrator with a warm, clean baritone and calm, restrained delivery (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[English] He had won. Then he kept going.</d> while all figures stay silent with their simple line mouths completely closed and no character dialogue occurs. The camera holds a static shot. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a macro close-up of the middle of the snake on the white floor. Two short electric-blue legs grow downward from the snake's body: one complete, the second drawn only halfway; the line forks clearly past its original outline. Focus pulls from the new legs to the background at frame right, where another figure's electric-blue line is still extending quickly. The same narrator (S1) continues in the same off-screen voiceover: <d>[English] A snake looks too simple, so he adds two feet.</d> while the figures stay silent with their mouths completely closed. The camera holds a static shot. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the shot cuts to a slightly low-angle medium close-up of the center figure. He straightens up and lifts his chin; one extra electric-blue leg is finished and the second is left half-drawn. The red wine inside the gold vessel in his left hand tilts and sways. In the background at frame right, the second figure's electric-blue snake closes head to tail and one electric-blue pulse runs around its outline. The same narrator (S1) continues in the same off-screen voiceover: <d>[English] The rule never asked for feet.</d> while the figures stay silent with their mouths completely closed. The camera tilts up with small amplitude at slow speed. Throughout the segment the canvas stays flat pure white with no texture, gradient, shadow, or depth; no on-screen text, letters, numbers, captions, subtitles, signs, logos, or watermarks; no speech bubbles or dialogue boxes; no photorealistic people, faces, or 3D rendering; no extra limbs, fingers, detached hands, or additional figures beyond the three.

overall_soundscape: A fingertip scrapes lightly across the floor, and the wine sloshes softly inside the gold vessel as it is lifted. Faint dry strokes continue in the background, then one clean bright chime closes the distant snake. A short satisfied exhale is audible near the end.

non_diegetic_music: The identical sparse piano pattern and quiet sustained ambient pad continue at the same tempo and instrumentation, with slightly more frequent notes and a small rise in volume toward the end of the segment.
